reason: My register has never lost a bill and I count the drawer myself every night, so I already know my takings without an app. Putting every stylist on an app with a live view of who is in which chair will feel to my old staff like I am watching them, and I don't want to upset people who have been with me for years.
objection: My stylists will feel I don't trust them if I suddenly make them bill on their phones and track cancelled bills and walk-outs, and at both branches nobody will want to change how we have always done it.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing another established salon owner in Bhubaneswar whose senior staff actually took to it without feeling policed, and being allowed to keep my register running alongside it for the first months.
